name: transient-pairing-preservation
body: Preserving transient pairings across a durable mutation. A durable node/edge mutation's projection apply must, after deleting the mutation's exact FQN/edge delta, re-merge the assembled transient record set — the plan store plus every transient tier mirror — not the durable record set alone. Every pre-existing transient pairing incident to a changed FQN (in particular a `Feedback-[:Reviews]` edge) must survive the mutation with no transient write in between, so the projection remains equal to the durable layers plus the plan store plus all transient mirrors, and neither `apg review list` nor the verify gate's resolved-feedback and attachment checks are skewed. No code re-scan is involved.
